AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

18. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
